title: Arthroscopic lavage/debridement for knee osteoarthritis: sham-control reversal and de-adoption through guidelines, coverage, and EBI lists
summary: Promotes arthroscopic lavage/debridement for knee osteoarthritis as a procedure-reversal record. The record uses a placebo-surgery trial, a medical-therapy comparator trial, and de-adoption/guideline infrastructure to distinguish “patients improved” from “procedure-specific benefit.” Scope is restricted to degenerative/OA indications and does not generalize to all arthroscopic knee surgery.
